title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Muralidharan…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Push Notification for Post and BuddyPress plugin up to version 3.24. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
